items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 9:1
items.html: (To the question) All the statures of Atzilut are discerned by the name of the general MAH, and all the vessels that served in Nekudim, with the lights clothing in them for their correction, are called by the name of the general BAN. (Item 158).
